note: The human half of the watcher inventory. This file owns meaning: what a job does, and what it must never do. It owns nothing else. Status, cadence, last exit and output age are derived per run by es-ops/bin/emit_automation_inventory.py from launchctl and the job definitions on the owner's Mac, and written to automation.json. Rows are keyed by launchd label and render in the order below; a job the producer finds in scope with no entry here renders as "undocumented", which is how a job nobody has described surfaces instead of being silently absent. Prose is plain text: `backticks` become code, and nothing else becomes markup. Seeded 2026-09-04 from the hand-typed table this replaced.

fields.label: the launchd label, which is what joins this row to the machine
fields.display: what the table calls it; omit to use the script path launchd runs
fields.artifact: the output this job is supposed to leave behind, so its freshness can be measured
fields.fresh_after_seconds: how old that output may be before the row reads STALE; omit to derive twice the cadence
fields.by_hand: true for a row that is deliberately not an automation, so it can never be counted as one
fields.source: the existing classroom station from which this prose was copied
fields.observed_at: the date of the curated prose snapshot, separate from the machine reading

rows.label: com.lawrence.es-asc-verdict
rows.what_it_does: Reads the external review verdict on an interval and writes `es-ops/state/es-asc-verdict-latest.json`.
rows.must_never_do: Replace a live readback with a local document.

rows.label: com.lawrence.es-health-fingerprint
rows.what_it_does: Makes five bounded GET requests and three local freshness checks, and alerts only on a state change.
rows.must_never_do: Alert on an unmeasured claim.

rows.label: com.lawrence.es-kpi-watch
rows.what_it_does: Checks semantic probe assertions instead of treating a bare HTTP success as proof.
rows.must_never_do: Treat a bare HTTP success as proof.

rows.label: com.lawrence.es-ops-supervisor
rows.what_it_does: Checks watcher heartbeats and performs bounded heals with an audit record.
rows.must_never_do: Heal silently without an audit trail.

rows.label: com.lawrence.ai-ops-healthcheck
rows.what_it_does: Checks launchd exit codes and scheduled-job state with flap-damped alerts. It is the tick this inventory producer rides on.
rows.must_never_do: Turn a flapping job into noise.

rows.label: com.expiredsolutions.sauce-nightly
rows.what_it_does: Runs the newest candidate on physical devices and writes a summary record.
rows.must_never_do: Substitute an emulator result.

rows.cadence: no schedule; a human refreshes it
rows.what_it_does: A planner-maintained status page, refreshed by hand; not an automation. It carries review hours, pull request states, and an owner click list.
rows.must_never_do: Present its status page as independent release proof, or be listed as a scheduled job. Nothing schedules it.

rows.label: com.lawrencehua.es-prod-smoke
rows.what_it_does: A scheduled daily production POST probe that posts a green or incident line.
rows.must_never_do: Be presented as dormant while it is scheduled and posting.

rows.label: com.lawrence.model-improve
rows.what_it_does: This was a nightly self-improvement daemon that fired into a deleted script.
rows.must_never_do: Run a deleted script.

rows.label: com.lawrence.ai-agent-council
rows.what_it_does: This was a recurring summary of known facts.
rows.must_never_do: Restate facts as a substitute for measurement.

rows.label: com.es.b11-intern-post-20260902
rows.what_it_does: Posted diagrams once and wrote `es-ops/state/b11-posted.json`.
rows.must_never_do: Repeat after its one successful run.

rows.label: com.lawrencehua.es-feedback-digest
rows.what_it_does: Shopper feedback and scan corrections land in the production database. Every morning, launchd `com.lawrencehua.es-feedback-digest` (daily 09:15) runs `~/.openclaw/tools/feedback_digest/feedback_digest.py`, which pulls `/feedback/unreviewed` and `/scan-feedback/admin/corrections` from production and posts the queue to Slack `#es-daily`. The first live run was observed 2026-09-04 at 09:35 ET. From there the routing is human: digest to owner brief in `es-ops/briefs` to pull request. Scanner corrections also feed the ML loop, flag-only per the owner's 2026-09-03 decision.
rows.must_never_do: Open a pull request or apply a correction by itself. The digest reports; a person routes.

rows.label: com.lawrencehua.es-flywheel-steward
rows.what_it_does: The flywheel steward (launchd `com.lawrencehua.es-flywheel-steward`, daily 09:05, `~/system-map/comms/es_flywheel_steward.py`) watches the QUALITY, STORED, DEPLOYED, and ACTIVE axes, posts to `#es-daily`, and writes `~/system-map/_data/es-flywheel/steward-latest.json`.
rows.must_never_do: Apply its own fix card or promote a model. Findings become drafts; a person decides.

rows.label: com.lawrencehua.es-flywheel-heartbeat
rows.what_it_does: A dead-man heartbeat (daily 12:15) watches the steward itself.
rows.must_never_do: Apply its own fix card or promote a model. Findings become drafts; a person decides.

rows.label: com.lawrencehua.es-mesh-bridge
rows.what_it_does: The mesh bridge (daily 09:35) turns findings into gated draft fix cards and never auto-applies them.
rows.must_never_do: Apply its own fix card or promote a model. Findings become drafts; a person decides.

rows.label: com.lawrence.xpired-gate-canary
rows.what_it_does: a serving canary probes the content gate every 30 minutes.
rows.must_never_do: Apply its own fix card or promote a model. Findings become drafts; a person decides.

rows.label: com.lawrence.xpired-a11y-monitor
rows.what_it_does: Overnight, a Sauce real-device matrix runs nightly at 23:17 and an accessibility monitor runs daily at 08:47.
rows.must_never_do: Pass with a deleted suite, a hand-typed count, or an unverified toolchain.

rows.label: com.lawrence.es-release-dryrun
rows.what_it_does: a daily release dry-run at 07:00 exercises the whole path without authority.
rows.must_never_do: Rebuild between canary and production, or submit without the readiness gate. Tombstones must never run.

rows.label: com.lawrence.es-overseer-digest
rows.what_it_does: the overseer digest lands in `#es-daily` at 08:40
rows.must_never_do: Heal silently without an audit trail, or alert on an unmeasured claim.

rows.label: com.lawrence.es-dream
rows.what_it_does: a 03:30 job consolidates the day's learning
rows.must_never_do: Heal silently without an audit trail, or alert on an unmeasured claim.

rows.label: com.lawrence.es-expired-agent
rows.what_it_does: the `@Expired` Slack bot, live since 2026-09-04, answers intern questions grounded in immutable repository snapshots.
rows.must_never_do: Heal silently without an audit trail, or alert on an unmeasured claim.
